description: DERIVED — global Claude.ai usage share by O*NET-SOC occupation, v2 (early 2025): task shares apportioned equally across occupations sharing a task statement. The apportionment is an Atana methodological choice, not an Anthropic figure. Pairs with atana.oecd_ai (expert-rated frame) — full occupation-level pairing gated on oecd_ai Tier 2.
